title: Exploratory missions
summary: Exploratory missions use an informed subagent to explore on the controller, or drive a declared Test Machine without adding a source checkout. Main owns the report and verdict; unsupported executors refuse with a named recovery. A stopped mission with no product proof settles as mission_setup_blocked with an error verdict and its named prerequisite; diagnostic and restore artifacts do not earn human review. Authors split missions by machine for parallel host queues and order a small cross-machine mission after single-machine missions. Hostless missions explore on the controller, record a docket without a lease, and need no reset or restore receipt; explicit host declarations retain host custody and starting-state checks. Frozen snapshots ignore stale starting-state declarations on cases that need no Test Machine; plan authoring still refuses those stray fields.
